notes.title: Update 3.0.5.0 - Merging the Legacy and Beach Resort Versions!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are excited to present a new update for Spirit of the Island, where we finally can ditch the legacy version and have a unified experience between all platforms: PC, Console and upcoming Mobile! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/724c7d047e0803f9188af15180f3efb86377c827.jpg[/img]

We will present patchnotes for both PC and Console versions, respectively. 

[b]PC:[/b]
- Fixed various errors in coop mode;
- By merging the version, we've reduced the size of the game by half! Meaning that the install size will be ~3GB.
- Fixed various problems with controllers;
- Fixed an old bug with marriage;
- We've added drag and drop system for PC version! Now you can manage your inventories more conveniently;
- We've also optimised the game to load faster;
- We've changed the Host-Second player interaction the New Story coop mode: now, only the host can finish the active quests. Second player can still interact with all NPCs and do everything else. This was done to ensure maximum compatibility and stability of the gameplay in New Story. 
- Fixed rare issue, when achievements didn't unlock for some players;
- Fixed a very rare issue, when host's and second players save files were swapped.

More fixes for PC version will come soon after the Mobile release, probably in about two weeks from the date.

[b]PC and Console versions are now exactly the same, so there is no launch option for a legacy one now. You just need to launch the game, select region and play![/b]

[b]Consoles:[/b]
- Added the new story
- This update also adds Adventureland and Beach Resort DLCs with all of their content for free!
- All above fixes for achievements, controllers and other issues.

As a reminder: you can opt for the launch of SOTI on mobile stores! Here are the links:
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pid.spirit]Android[/url]
[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spirit-of-the-island/id6449941289]iOS[/url]

Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: New Story Update is Live!
notes.content:
We are very excited to launch the New Story Update! To celebrate the occasion, Spirit of the Island will have a 65% discount for the base game and 20% discount for the Adventureland DLC until February 20th! The discount will launch in 1 hour!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/662b5de2b5871fe9f1d51c8e9be3c416c6d0c519.jpg[/img]

New Story mode brings completely reworked quests, dialogues and main story line for both single player and co-op modes. And yes, the story is now the same in both modes. That’s about 25 hours of brand new gameplay completely for free! It’s a great way to experience the game anew. We had a lot of feedback from our dear community  and we did our absolute best to rework everything from scratch. We don’t want to spoil too much here, but we hope that you and your friends are excited to visit our tropical paradise again in both single player and co-op! Oh, and don’t worry about the old story: it will be available as well! If you want to try it, select “Children of the Ocean” when you start the game. But we highly recommend playing the new one first, as it will be the most complete experience you could get!

We are also releasing steam trading cards! Everyone who already played the game will get their drops very quickly after some gameplay. We made emojis, backgrounds and other cool goodies for you to decorate your steam profile!

And for our achievement hunters: we’ve fixed all achievements! You should be able to get 100% without a problem now — sorry for the long wait!

And to add ever more spice to the news: sometime in April, the mobile version of Spirit of the Island will be released for iOS and Android — and it will support crossplay with PC and Consoles! You will be able to play SOTI anywhere you’d like, at home or on the go. And in early summer, we will release a new story and all updated stuff for consoles, finally merging the two versions together. Please wait for the news about both releases!

We’d like to say a huge thanks to our community for supporting us for such a long time. We are preparing a lot of exciting things and new games, so we hope you stick with us for the new releases!

Yours dearly,

1M Bits Horde and Meta Publishing.

notes.title: Free DLC - Beach Resort - Is Now Available for Download!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! 

We have an exciting surprise for everyone. Our first DLC - Beach Resort -  is now available for download for FREE! You've read that right: we've decided to make our first content DLC free of charge for all players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/c74c313b8cf31030f098ea847d52701358bd82bc.jpg[/img]

Spirit of The Island: Beach Resort DLC will give you an option to pick a brand new starting location: Beach Resort.  Almost all of the new Island's area can be used for building (even the beaches!) - just imagine what kind of a resort you can create there! Combine it with the new increased tourist limits and the luxurious dream will finally become a reality. We can't wait to see your creations, so please share some screeshots later!

Very important: Beach Resort is only available when you start a brand new save game, due to some technical limitations. But isn't it nice to have a fresh start once in a while?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/6207b9c2c1ce0d83ad0d639e81875c1aabb0cf8d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419840/Spirit_of_the_Island__Beach_Resort

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/e9d96396b5e965c33ab0a6317da47b0d622e5c7c.png[/img]

In one hour from this post, we'll launch our biggest sale yet: SOTI will be taking part in Cozy and Family Games event and will receive the biggest discount to date: 61%. The offer will last until May, 5th, 17:00 UTC. Don't miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/d591fff6d505fc84af387485a6f575bd0f09e962.jpg[/img]

Last, but not least - the patchnotes! They aren't super big, since the biggest change is the new DLC, but we do have some fixes as well!

Thank you for being with us! We have a lot more things to share in the coming days, so stay tuned for exciting updates and announcements.

For now they will roam around your farm and consume some foods, but in later updates we'll add new interactions with them. You can have 2 pets maximum for now.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/831dd11139fec4e26df3cc14e9f453764a56f427.png[/img]

notes.title: The updated roadmap
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today we  are presenting the updated roadmap for Spirit of the Island. We've had a big and long look at all of your feedback about the game and after some discussions decided on a most realistic roadmap for the present year. Please do note, that this is only about new features and improvements, regular bug fixes will continue as usual. 

Now, to outline some things: 
- In September we plan to vastly improve things that everyone is asking for, mainly inventory and the map of the game. We'll bring drag and drop, better handling with the controller, map will have new visuals and pointers and so on. It should be a very good. improvement. 
- For October, we'll be working on Greenhouse - a brand new building that will act like a house for your plants at Winter. It will have upgrades, several floors and lots of space to plant and decorate. Since it will be movable, we'll also add that option to your house. 
- November might look kinda "meh", but trust us, it's a big and complex system and requires a lot of work. We'd like to even have multiplayer marriages between players as well and this will need a lot of testing and development time. 
- And finally, December. We plan to add Pets and Banking this month, which will add another level of depth to the game. 

We hope the new updates will bring you joy and fun. Please continue to leave reviews and contact us on Steam and the Discord server with your suggestions and feedback. 
Thank you for your support, and we wish you an enjoyable time at our Tropical Paradise!

Today we would like to talk about the release and our future plans.

We held a Kickstarter campaign with a certain road map and a set content plan. We’ve had a promise to our backers to release everything originally planned this Summer and we did exactly so, with all originally planned content.

So why did we have early access in the first place? It was done to have an opportunity to work on the game with our community. A lot of changes and fixes we made during the early access are based on your help and feedback. And we are really grateful for that.

What about QoL and future updates? We are going to release a new patch tomorrow with new improvements and fixes. You can find a list of changes below. Also we are going to add inventory UI and few more QoL improvements next week. And we want to add drag & drop as soon as possible. 

We will present an updated roadmap next week. We already have tons of ideas, but we're looking closely at your feedback now and we are ready to add new QoL features there. Please treat 1.0 as a feature complete milestone. It’s the game with everything originally planned plus more from your feedback. And we won’t stop here. 

The work on the project WILL NOT stop anytime soon! Moreover, we will continue to support the game in 2023. We are working on porting the game to consoles already and we will start porting the game to mobile next year. We have promised and we'll have full cross-platform co-op between ALL platforms, including mobile. Isn’t it fun?

[b]New Creatures[/b] - just in time to test your new armour and weapons!

Link to the survey - [url=https://strawpoll.com/polls/mpnbaEbewy5]https://strawpoll.com/polls/mpnbaEbewy5[/url]

Have a great day!

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello friends! How’s it going?

The big day is finally here! We are proud to announce that we are ready to reveal the release date of Early Access!

As we’ve announced before, we decided to postpone the Early Access release to ensure the best possible launch for everyone, and that commitment still stands. Now we are in a place where we can guarantee the best possible experience for everyone - from our dear Backers to all the new players.  So mark the date in your calendars, folks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40309583/54ab042c340bf0df1ce84e776e51e91d332de215.jpg[/img]
 
We’ve prepared many fun activities for the Early Access launch too! A little teaser: we’ll be having a fun contest with very nice prizes, so hone your creative skills. But that’s all we can say right now!

New Features Awaiting You in Early Access
While we did move the release further into the future, the work has never ceased, and Spirit of the Island is looking better than ever. Since November, we’ve been running a special Backer Access version for our Kickstarter backers. And it’s going on incredibly well! Our amazing backers gave us lots of valuable feedback. We’ve already implemented many things that otherwise wouldn’t be in the Early Access day one. To list some examples:

[list]
[*] Repair function — now you can use your hammer to fix other tools (not another hammer, though!) at the expense of the hammer’s durability;
[*] Toggling “Item Drag” in the settings — sometimes you don’t need a magnet for dropped items so that it can be safely disabled now;
[*] Improved water — it looks better than ever now;
[*] Added key bindings, one of the most requested features;
[*] Two new Islands for you to explore!
[/list]
And lots of other stuff! We dive deeper into our latest additions in the development blog, which we released a few weeks before. If you missed it - here it is!

[previewyoutube=ZHysTJ-KhI4;full][/previewyoutube]
 
And we aren’t stopping here! Spirit of the Island is all about community-driven development so expect even more feedback-based changes and improvements when we go into Early Access!

We are super excited and can't wait to launch Spirit of the Island officially! Nothing of this would have been possible without the help and support of our dear Backers and the amazing community. To everyone - HUGE thanks!

We'll see you in March!

notes.content:
Hi! We just released a new update, which will address the common issues and your feedback! Huge thanks to everyone in the community for helping us improve the game! More updates will come later, so stay tuned!

- Added a few more items for the demo.

- Improved backpack scrolling.

- Improved stairs colliders.

- Fixed the case when you could gather or use items while being far away from them.

- Fixed wrong crafting output when crafting items.
- Fixed wrong crop collider (after changing player movement).
- Fixed invisible wall problem near the mountains.
- Items won't disappear from treasure chests after you exit the game now. (you need to start a new game for this fix to work).
- Fixed the possibility of damaging enemies a lot if they are stuck.
- Fixed the game error when you try to destroy blue grass.
- Improved the stairs collision model so you won't get stuck anymore.
